Markup-fidelity fixture for the alert component. See ../README.md and button.json/card.json for the model. Goldens are the canonical snippets/alerts.html + _alerts.scss shape. The alert has TWO blessed markup shapes (snippet 'WITH vs WITHOUT icon'): WITH an icon the non-icon content is wrapped in .pa-alert__content (icon + content are the two flex children); WITHOUT an icon the structural children (__heading / __list / __actions /

) go DIRECT into .pa-alert (each gets flex-basis:100%). Both wrappers implement both shapes keyed on the icon slot.

propsVocabulary.outline: boolean — border-only, transparent bg (guards to solid fill for variants core has no outline for: secondary/light/dark)
propsVocabulary.themeColor: 1..9 theme colour slot (overrides named variant; combines with outline → outline-color-N)
propsVocabulary.dismissible: boolean — padding-inline-end for the close button + renders .pa-alert__close
propsVocabulary.multiline: boolean — opt out of align-items:center so an icon top-aligns with a multi-line __content stack
propsVocabulary.heading: heading text rendered as <h4 class=pa-alert__heading>
propsVocabulary.headingLarge: boolean — bump heading to pa-alert__heading--lg (deliberate-read presentation)
propsVocabulary.body: main content — bare children (WITHOUT icon: direct child of pa-alert; WITH icon: inside pa-alert__content)
propsVocabulary.icon: leading icon rendered inside pa-alert__icon; its presence wraps the rest in pa-alert__content

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the core snippet shape PLUS the conventions both wrappers legitimately add over the static snippet: (1) every alert carries role="alert" (the snippet blesses it for dynamic/dismissible alerts and both wrappers emit it unconditionally); (2) the .pa-alert__close is a <button type="button"> (sensible default preventing implicit form submit inside a form). Slot content is a plain text token so the diff checks structural nesting, not rich content — the icon slot is text (real usage is a <span class=pa-icon>). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (NOT components.json — misses SCSS-@for/@each variants). `produces` is a class template; capability.mjs expands it and cross-checks against main.css AND each wrapper map + scenarios. `produces: null` = structural/native (no pa-alert modifier). Axis-1 reverse-check is block-modifier-scoped (pa-alert--*); element modifiers (pa-alert__heading--lg) are verified forward.

headingLarge.note: element modifier on the heading; only meaningful together with `heading`. Verified forward against CSS.

icon.note: presence also wraps the rest of the content in pa-alert__content

body.note: structural — bare content; wrapped in pa-alert__content only when an icon is present

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: pa-alert element/content classes emitted structurally (not as block-modifier props), plus the close button. The axis-1 reverse check is block-modifier-scoped (pa-alert--*), so these __-element classes don't trip it — listed here for documentation only.
cssStateClasses.pa-alert__content: content wrapper emitted when an icon is present (feature: icon)
